# Lira

> Lira is an AI customer support platform that learns your product and resolves
> customer conversations across a chat widget, an embedded in-app support
> surface, a support portal, email, voice, and WhatsApp. It grounds every answer
> in your knowledge base (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), opens tickets with
> full context when a human is needed, and can take secure, approved actions
> inside your product. Built by Creovine. Website: https://liraintelligence.com

## What Lira does

- **Answers grounded in your knowledge**: Lira ingests your docs, help center, web pages, and Google Drive, indexes them, and answers customer questions using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) — citing your real content instead of guessing.
- **Works across every channel**: one AI agent across a website chat widget, an embedded in-app support surface (Web SDK), a hosted branded support portal, email, inbound voice (rolling out), and the WhatsApp Business API.
- **Resolves tickets, not just deflects**: when Lira can't resolve an issue, it opens a ticket with the full transcript, verified customer identity, and knowledge snippets attached, and keeps chatting in parallel. SLA tracking, queues, routing, and CSAT included.
- **Hands off to humans cleanly**: any teammate reply pauses the AI (human takeover) until handback; escalation triggers on low confidence or on sensitive intents (fraud, billing disputes, account security).
- **Takes real action in your product**: register actions Lira can run on a customer's behalf (cancel a subscription, retry a payment, resend an invoice, change a plan) with per-action approval policy — auto-confirm, require customer approval, or require human review.
- **Proactive outreach**: event-triggered messages (failed payment, onboarding nudge, renewal) across email and the widget, with cooldowns and daily caps.
- **Learns over time**: when Lira answers poorly it drafts knowledge-base entries for admin approval, improving future answers.

## For developers

- **MCP connector**: connect your own Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so Lira can call your tools (check a transaction, freeze a card, schedule a callback) under your own auth, on your infrastructure. Remote (HTTPS) transport, bearer token or OAuth 2.1, per-tool approval, per-tool/per-server rate limits, change/drift detection, config audit logging, and SSRF/DNS-rebinding protection.
- **Developer API keys & CLI**: scoped, hashed, revocable API keys and an `@liraintelligence/support` CLI to connect MCP servers, approve tools, and mint short-lived customer session tokens.
- **Native mobile support SDK**: build native in-app support (the way Cash App, Monzo, and Revolut do) over Lira's chat WebSocket — your backend mints a session token, your app opens the socket, with confirm-before-action, step-up re-auth for higher-risk actions, and human takeover.
- **Chat widget install**: one `<script>` tag with your org ID; optional signed customer identity (HMAC) for verified, personalized support.

## Security & governance

- Actions are **off by default and opt-in per tool**; overrides can only tighten risk/scope, never loosen it.
- The acting customer's identity is bound **server-side** from the authenticated session, never from model or chat text (IDOR / confused-deputy defense).
- Sensitive operations run on **your own backend via MCP under your auth**, so account data and money movement never leave your infrastructure.
- Every action is risk-tiered, human-confirmable, rate-limited, and **dual-side audited** (Lira's log plus your own MCP-server logs).
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest via KMS; connection secrets and OAuth credentials encrypted and never shown back in the dashboard.
- Primary reasoning model: Anthropic Claude Sonnet, with GPT-4o fallback; Amazon Nova Sonic is used only for optional voice speech I/O.
- Compliance status (honest): the technical controls above are implemented today. A DPA, security questionnaire, and data-handling/residency documentation are available on request. SOC 2 attestation and third-party penetration-test reports are on the enterprise roadmap and are **not yet certified**.

## Who it's for

- Regulated fintechs and teams operating near money or KYC.
- B2B SaaS products embedding support into a logged-in app.
- Consumer apps that want native in-app support.

## Pricing

- **Free** — $0, includes a chat widget, knowledge base, lead capture, and unlimited team seats.
- **Pro** — from $29/mo, adds conversation flows, AI read actions, more languages, and analytics.
- **Scale** — from $99/mo, adds AI that takes approved actions with audit, the WhatsApp channel, and custom API/MCP.
- **Enterprise** — custom, adds SSO/SAML, custom retention, and dedicated onboarding.
- Every plan includes **unlimited team seats** — you pay for the AI's work, never per agent.
- Details: https://liraintelligence.com/pricing
